description: Women in Healthcare at Purdue (WiH) is an inclusive student club open to all Purdue students interested in pursuing a career in healthcare, with a focus on supporting and celebrating women in the field.

name: Women in Industrial and Systems Engineering
description: WISE aims to provide a space for IEs to foster professional connections, create a community of fellow peers and give back to their communities that they came from in outreach, social, and professional opportunities set forth by the organization.

name: Women In Law
description: "Women in Law" is a network where women come together to enhance their future legal careers, make meaningful connections, and share a collective passion for the law. This organization offers opportunities for learning, support, and inspiration for women.

name: Women in Materials Science Engineering
description: To promote the field of Materials Engineering and create a community space that is open to all!

name: Women in Mechanical Engineering at Purdue
description: WiME is a student organization by and for the women of Purdue Mechanical Engineering built to foster scholarship, community, and growth.

name: Women in Motorsports Council at Purdue
description: Our organization aims to empower women across the motorsports teams at Purdue and provide resources to succeed in the motorsports industry.

name: Women In Nuclear at Purdue University
description: WIN supports women and men who work in nuclear-related fields by promoting diversity and inclusion in the nuclear fields at Purdue University and providing resources and opportunities for personal and professional development.

name: Women In Philosophy Society - Purdue Chapter
description: A community of women with a passion for Philosophy.

name: Women in Sales Club at Purdue
description: The objective of this organization is to promote business acumen in women pursuing a career in sales, or that have an interest in sales.

name: Women in Technology
description: Women in Technology (WIT) was founded as a student organization in 1998 at Purdue University in the School of Technology. Women in Technology's purpose is to develop leaders and personal as well as professional relationships through group activities

name: Women of Color in Healthcare Association
description: Women of Color in Healthcare Association, abbreviated WCHA, serves to foster an environment conducive to the upbringing of rising healthcare professionals, specifically, but not limited to, those who are minority women or possess marginalized backgrounds

name: Women's Club Basketball at Purdue

name: Women's Global Health Institute Student Chapter
description: We aim to bring more graduate and undergraduate student involvement to the WGHI, to promote academic and social communication of scientific advances in women’s health.

name: Women's Volleyball Club at Purdue Indianapolis
description: The Women’s Volleyball Club at Purdue Indianapolis provides an inclusive space for students of all skill levels to play volleyball, stay active, build friendships, and compete recreationally or competitively with other universities and clubs.

name: Women's Wrestling Club of Purdue
description: WWCP promotes women’s freestyle wrestling at Purdue in a welcoming and diverse environment. Members will develop skills, leadership, and teamwork while fostering an active lifestyle. WWCP empowers women and fosters gender equality in athletics.

name: Woodcarvers of Purdue University
description: This Organization is focused towards the furthering of the art of woodcarving through teaching new students the techniques and skills needed to carve.

name: World Peace Buddhists

name: Worldwide Discipleship Association
description: WDA is a campus ministry that reaches out to students of all backgrounds.

name: XSeries Dance
description: XSeries Dance provides opportunities for students in the School of Visual and Performing Arts dance classes to perform choreography by student artists and participate in a variety of performances on the Purdue Campus.

name: Young Democratic Socialists of Purdue
description: As democratic socialists, we are united in the struggle for a better world and stand in solidarity with the working class through community work, community organizing, and political education. Affiliated with the Young Democratic Socialists of America

name: Young Life at Purdue
description: Young Life is a leadership training program that prepares leaders to work with area teenagers and share God's love with them.

name: Young Professionals of Human Resource Development
description: The Young Professionals of HRD student organization is an academic student organization designed to enrich the professional development of Purdue HRD majors. Our core values are Professionalism, Community, Personal Leadership, and Service.

name: Zeta Beta Tau Fraternity

name: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc. Epsilon Kappa Chapter
description: Thank you visiting our Boiler Link profile, Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc. is poised for perpetual service to mankind. It espouses the highest academic ideals and that has resulted in its members serving in groundbreaking roles in all fields of endeavor.

name: Zeta Psi

name: Zeta Tau Alpha

name: Zucrow Student Association
